items.q: But -- and Benny Payne, the great pianist, who is

ctx.x: Yes, he was on the bill. This is when he did It Ain't Necessarily So and, of course, Minnie the Moocher, that was the theme song of his big band in those days. And I think how that came about, you know, he traveled -- the past few years he's been traveling with the Globetrotters, the famous basketball team, and during the intermissions, he's been doing the talking and the singing and whatnot. Well, here a few years (inaudible) back -- I had the pleasure of doing this on -- I think I was in Minneapolis. And he was…
But -- and Benny Payne, the great pianist, who is

now with the great Billy Daniels, was in Cab Calloway's band at that time, and was his pianist, you know. So Cab relied upon these guys in the -- he was the type of fellow that, if an arranger brought an arrangement in, he would let you rehearse the band, and he'd sit back, and you blew a couple of times go it over and he'd walk up to you and and Father Payne says, "I got it now."
